title: BDLB Agent Invocation Audit Record
description: Audit record written every time the BDLB orchestrator dispatches a sub-agent at runtime. One record per dispatch attempt.

invocation_id.description: Unique identifier for this single dispatch attempt. UUID-shaped.

agent_name.description: Name of the dispatched sub-agent. MUST match an agent filename under bdlb/agents/ with the .md extension removed.

spec_version.description: Version string declared in the agent spec front-matter at dispatch time.

spec_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the agent .md spec file contents at dispatch time. Lower-case hex.

model.description: Exact model identifier used for this invocation (e.g. claude-opus-4-7).

temperature.description: Sampling temperature used for this invocation.

input_hash.description: SHA-256 of the canonical JSON-serialized inputs bundle passed to the sub-agent. Lower-case hex.

output_hash.description: SHA-256 of the canonical JSON-serialized outputs bundle returned by the sub-agent. Lower-case hex. For non-success status, hash of whatever partial/empty output was captured.

started_at.description: Timestamp when the orchestrator dispatched the sub-agent. RFC 3339 / ISO 8601 date-time, UTC recommended.

ended_at.description: Timestamp when the orchestrator received the sub-agent's terminal response (or hit timeout). RFC 3339 / ISO 8601 date-time.

status.description: Terminal status of this single invocation attempt.

attempt_number.description: Which retry attempt this is for the given (agent_name, logical task) pair. 1-indexed. BDLB retry cap is 3.

inputs_ref.description: Relative path (from repo root) to the persisted inputs.json snapshot for this invocation.

outputs_ref.description: Relative path (from repo root) to the persisted outputs file produced by this invocation.

error.description: Error message string when status is not 'success'. MUST be null when status is 'success'.
